_comment: vehicle-e2e: engine-cut hold offer (send once stopped) + held/never-stopped command states

en.vehHoldTitle: Not sent: the vehicle is moving

@vehHoldTitle.description: vehicle-e2e: dialog title when an engine cut is refused because the vehicle is moving

en.vehHoldBody: Assisto can wait and send the engine cut only after the vehicle has stopped. If it does not stop within {min} minutes, nothing is sent and you are told.

@vehHoldBody.description: vehicle-e2e: hold offer; min = minutes, already in UI digits

@vehHoldCta.description: vehicle-e2e: button, hold the engine cut until the vehicle stops

@vehHoldNo.description: vehicle-e2e: button, do not hold the engine cut

en.vehHoldQueued: Waiting for the vehicle to stop. The engine cut is sent only then (up to {min} minutes).

@vehHoldQueued.description: vehicle-e2e: snack after a held cut was confirmed; min in UI digits

en.vehCmdStHeld: waiting for the vehicle to stop (up to {min} min)

@vehCmdStHeld.description: vehicle-e2e: command row state of a held engine cut; min in UI digits

en.vehCmdStNeverStopped: not sent: the vehicle did not stop in time

@vehCmdStNeverStopped.description: vehicle-e2e: command row state when a held cut expired because the vehicle never stopped

bn.vehHoldBody: Assisto অপেক্ষা করে গাড়ি থামার পরেই ইঞ্জিন বন্ধের নির্দেশ পাঠাতে পারে। {min} মিনিটের মধ্যে না থামলে কিছুই পাঠানো হবে না, আর আপনাকে জানানো হবে।
bn.vehHoldQueued: গাড়ি থামার অপেক্ষায়। তখনই ইঞ্জিন বন্ধের নির্দেশ যাবে (সর্বোচ্চ {min} মিনিট)।
